section_summary.extract_value: This procedural section describes a single study (Study X) conducted in the United Kingdom where participants were recruited via Prolific Academic on May 18–19, 2018, and completed an online survey hosted on Qualtrics. Eligibility was limited to UK citizens of adult age with high Prolific approval ratings (≥96), and the survey took approximately 12 minutes to complete with participants receiving £1.00 compensation.
